subject: Recap + next steps (procurement & security)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>, Bob Smith <bob.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + next steps (procurement & security)

Hi Alice / Bob,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:  

Recap from today's discovery:
- Use case: ACME is evaluating Redwood for in-product LLM features (recommendations + summarization) across customer support workflows.
- Expected volume: initial pilot ~5M tokens/month, scale to ~50M over 12 months if results hit targets.
- Latency/cost sensitivity: procurement will evaluate unit economics and prefer predictability.

Key procurement/security items we discussed and asks:
1) SOC 2 Type II: you mentioned this is required for procurement sign-off — attaching our security pack which includes the SOC 2 artifact.
2) DPA: we can send a standard DPA; happy to accept your redlines or sign via DocuSign.
3) Security questionnaire: if you can share the questionnaire, we will prioritize responses and tag any answers that require engineering input.
4) Commercial path: is procurement likely to process via PO (Net terms) or do you expect a card/direct purchase? Also flagged: any interest in marketplace procurement (Azure/AWS) instead of a direct contract?

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- Please share procurement contact and the questionnaire (if available) — target: responses within 3 business days.
- I will send the DPA draft and a DocuSign link for quick signature if that accelerates things.
- Internal: I will loop in our security and legal for any engineering-level Qs.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Pack_v2.pdf (SOC 2 excerpt, pen test summary, security contacts).

If this looks right, can you confirm procurement preference (PO vs card) and whether they prefer marketplace billing?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123


From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>

Date: 2027-02-15T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps (procurement & security)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the follow up and the pack — appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from procurement/security side:

- SOC 2 / DPA: SOC 2 Type II is required. We will need a signed DPA before a PO is issued. Please send the DPA and the SOC 2 report or a link to download.
- Security questionnaire: I've attached our baseline questionnaire for pilots (Acme_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). Please have your security team fill what they can; we'll escalate any open items.
- Commercial path: procurement prefers issuing a PO (Net 30) for pilots. We sometimes use marketplace billing, but for pilots we generally request a direct PO and contract. Will confirm if any exceptions exist.

Procurement lead: Bob Smith (cc'd) is our PO owner. Bob — can you confirm the PO process/timeline?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Johnson | Head of Product Operations | Acme Corp
alice.johnson@acme.com

Attachments: Acme_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

2) SOC 2: public link to our latest SOC 2 Type II report is here: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/SOC2_Type_II_2026.pdf
3) Questionnaire: we will return a completed version of Acme_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx within 3 business days. Dev (cc) will own any engineering clarifications.
4) Commercial: we can accept PO with Net terms or card. If Acme would prefer marketplace invoicing, we can evaluate but PO/direct contract is fine for pilots.

Next steps I will take now:
- Send DocuSign DPA link (above) and upload a copy to the deal record in HubSpot (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-2027-032).
- Internal: loop security/legal to prioritize the questionnaire responses and confirm any items that require engineering.

Best,
Marissa
